title: RunManifest
description: Machine-readable manifest for one social-storytelling-ops run, referenced by stages/02_series-plan (series plan output), stages/06_publish (APPROVED gate), and cron/daily-content-digest.json. Written once per run at runs/<run_id>/manifest.json.

platform.description: Target platform per Postiz integration name, e.g. instagram, tiktok, x, linkedin.

hook.description: The cold-open/hook line, for a human scanning the daily digest without opening the full draft.

draft_path.description: Path to the full draft/edit-brief this manifest entry summarizes.

status.description: DRAFT: reel-director/opus-operator still producing it. NEEDS-REVIEW: awaiting taste-reviewer/truth-privacy-reviewer verdicts. PENDING-APPROVAL: passed both reviews, awaiting the daily human approval digest (cron/daily-content-digest.json). APPROVED: human approved — publishing-operator may now call schedule_post/publish_now (stages/06_publish). REJECTED: human rejected with a reason; a bounded revision task exists, see revision_of. SCHEDULED / PUBLISHED: set by publishing-operator/verifier after the approval gate.

rejection_reason.description: One-line human reason, present only when status is REJECTED. Read by stages/08_learn to update lessons.md — see Part 6 wiring.

revision_of.description: reel_id of the manifest entry a REJECTED reel's bounded revision task was created for. Present only on the new revision entry, not on the rejected original.
